Package com.vector.cfg.model.groovy.api

Automation scripting API for convenient MDF model access in Groovy code clients.

See: Description

  • Interface Summary 
    Interface Description
    IActiveEcucApi
    The IActiveEcucApi API provides some means to retrieve available modules in the (active) ECUC.
    IMdfFeatureListHasDefinitionExtensions<T extends com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.model.autosar.ecucdescription.MIHasDefinition>
    The interface IMdfFeatureListHasDefinitionExtensions defines some method extensions for MDF child lists to create and add new Ecuc object instances with definition (containers or parameters).
    IMdfFeatureListReferrableExtensions<T extends com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.commoncore.autosar.MIReferrable>
    The interface IMdfFeatureListReferrableExtensions defines some method extensions for MDF child lists to create and add new MIReferrable child objects.
    IMdfFeatureListSubContainerExtensions
    The interface IMdfFeatureListSubContainerExtensions defines some method extensions for MDF child lists to create and add new sub-containers.
    IMdfFeatureListTypeExtensions<T extends MIObject>
    The interface IMdfFeatureListTypeExtensions defines some method extensions for MDF child lists to create and add new MDF object instances.
    IMdfModelApi
    The IMdfModelApi API provides methods which allow retrieving and modifying MDF model objects in different ways.
    IMdfModelSettings
    The IMdfModelSettings provides means to configure the read and write model behavior for the MDF model objects.
    IMicrosarQuery
    Interface for MICROSAR QUERY.
    IModelApiEntryPoint
    IModelApiEntryPoint is the entry point for MDF model read access.
    IModelSynchronizationApi
    The Model synchronization provides operation to solve and synchronize common model related items.
    IOperations
    IOperations is the entry point for some complex operations on the AUTOSAR data model.
    ISystemDescriptionApi
    The systemDescription API provides methods to retrieve system description data like the path to the flat extract or the flat map instance.
    ISystemDescriptionApi.ISystemDescriptionAutosar4
    ISystemDescriptionApi.ISystemDescriptionAutosar4 provies access to AUTOSAR 4 system description elements like the flat map.
    ISystemDescriptionApi.ISystemDescriptionPaths
    ISystemDescriptionApi.ISystemDescriptionPaths defines common paths of the system description elements like the location of the flat map.
    ITransactionApi
    The ITransactionApi provides some transaction specific means which are available inside a running transaction only.
    ITransactionApiEntryPoint
    ITransactionApiEntryPoint is the entry point for MDF model write access and model transaction handling.
    ITransactionHistoryApi
    ITransactionHistoryApi is the entry point for dealing with the transaction history.
    ITransactionsApi
    ITransactionsApi defines the API to handle model transactions and the transaction history.
    IVarianceApi
    The IVarianceApi provides some means to deal with model variance for PreBuild and PostBuild variance
    IVarianceApiEntryPoint
    IVarianceApiEntryPoint is the entry point for handling variant model content.
  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    ModelConverters
    ModelConverters provides general purpose Functions performing value conversions used throughout the automation interface.
  • Enum Summary 
    Enum Description
    EModelNavigatorCreationMode

    EModelNavigatorCreationMode

    The EModelNavigatorCreationMode enum defines how the model navigator shall create model content in the write mode.
